name: Flexible Pointer
summary: A flexible 3D pointing technique that bends the pointer path, allowing users to select fully or partially obscured objects in augmented and virtual reality environments.
howItWorks: The user controls a virtual pointer whose shape can bend around occluding objects. Instead of pointing only along a straight line, the pointer can curve toward a target that is not directly visible or not easily reachable with standard egocentric pointing.
advantages: Selecting objects that are partially hidden, visually occluded, or difficult to reach with a straight ray-based pointing technique.
limitations: The curved pointer may require additional control and can be harder to understand than simple raycasting, especially when users need to adjust the pointer shape precisely.
